text:
Anita S: quick heads-up — all-hands Wed 11:00am PT. short agenda: 1) Exec update + product wins (8m) 2) Policy deep-dive: hosted retention & PII defaults (12m) 3) Dedicated launch callouts + migration checklist (10m) 4) Live Q&A + 3-min actionables. please drop Qs here. :loudspeaker:
Rafael M: will the policy deep-dive include exact config examples for SDKs?
Anita S: yes — we'll show snippets for node/python SDKs, the console toggle flow for Dedicated, and the customer notification cadence.
Tess Y: accessibility note: enable live captions and transcripts, please.
Anita S: yes — captions on, transcript + slides posted after meeting. RecordingBot will link.
Jordan L: question for Q&A: is there any change to retention for non-prod/staging environments?
Nina P: quick ops reply — non-prod defaults remain short (14 days) unless teams request otherwise. Hosted production moves to 90-day rolling by default. Dedicated tenants can choose custom windows via the console.
Rafael M: billing question — does default 90-day retention change pricing?
Nina P: short answer: no change for default 90-day. Extended retention or long-term archives >90 days are billable add-ons; we'll include examples in slides.
Tess Y: can the slides include a two-line "what engineers need to do" they can forward to their teams? super helpful.
Anita S: yes — final slide will be a two-bullet checklist: 1) audit ingestion clients for PII header and update SDKs if needed; 2) validate Dedicated toggle in staging tenants.
Jordan L: also please include a sample API header and a small code snippet for the PII redact opt-in.
Anita S: adding a sample in the doc: ```
// HTTP header example
X-Redwood-PII-Redact: true
```
Nina P: ops note — Dedicated customers get an "opt-in to hosted defaults" toggle in Console > Tenant Settings. migration plan: 2-week gradual rollout for hosted, with checkpoints at day 3 and day 10.
Rafael M: will we notify customers ahead of rollout? cadence?
Nina P: yes — customer notifications at 30/14/3 days and a final confirmation 24h before enforcement. we'll post the customer-facing blurb in /docs/announcements and include the exact language.
Tess Y: for the Q&A, adding: how will this affect analytics exports and audit exports?
Nina P: analytics (aggregated metrics) unaffected; raw audit exports obey retention window unless customer requests archive (billable). we'll add a slide showing export exceptions.
Anita S: ops-bot: schedule reminders for Wed 11:00am PT (24h and 30m).
ops-bot: reminder scheduled — All-Hands Wed 11:00am PT — reminders set for 24h and 30m.
RecordingBot: I'll upload the recording + transcript to internal drive and post links here within ~1 hour after the meeting. captions enabled.
Rafael M: small ask — can we get the slide deck 1 hour before for a quick review?
Anita S: slides will be shared 1 hour before. post-meeting we'll publish slides + one-page roll-out checklist + timestamped transcript.
Jordan L: adding a security ops Q: will the PII redaction affect downstream alerts / incident logs?
Nina P: short answer: alerts keep metadata needed for triage; sensitive payloads will be redacted. we'll include an "impacts to incident workflows" slide.
Tess Y: thanks — I'll add a note to docs team to prepare the customer blurb.
Anita S: great — drop any other Qs here and we'll triage into the live Q&A. see you Wed. :rocket:
